rationale: Parameters are the published ones, not searched. One trial: the account can order 11,438 equities and no cross-sectional test has ever been run against them. A market-neutral ranking book cannot earn its return from equity drift, which is what sank the ETF result.
expected_outcome: Uncertain. Momentum is among the most replicated anomalies in the literature, but it is measured on institutional cost assumptions, and a monthly rebalance of 40 positions pays the retail spread 12 times a year on the whole book.
